messages.content:
You verify changes of the class "building" between two co-registered remote sensing images of the same place: T1 (earlier) and T2 (later).
Scope card for "building".
COUNTS as a building change:
- a building demolished (present in T1, absent in T2)
Does NOT count:
- shadows
- seasonal, illumination or color/tone differences of the same building
- edge responses caused by misregistration between T1 and T2
- vehicles and temporary piles or materials
- changes of non-building land cover (roads, vegetation, bare soil)
- a building replaced by a different building at the same location (answer no, type rebuilt). Land, soil or vegetation in T1 with a building in T2 is new construction, not a replacement
- changes in the appeared direction; replacement alone is not evidence of the requested direction
Quote the scope card when you decide.

content.text: Judge only the area INSIDE the red contour, not adjacent buildings or changes outside it. Does this area show clear evidence of the requested building change between T1 and T2? A roof fragment can be part of a real change, but do not infer change from a different object nearby. Answer yes only when the two dates support that change inside the candidate; otherwise answer no. Follow the scope card and requested direction. Reply JSON only: {"change":"yes" or "no","reason":"one short evidence sentence"}. Requested direction: disappeared. Blue pixels mark regions already included in the initial answer, not the candidate; judge only the unoccluded red-contour candidate.
